items.title: Joe Mares Jr. Interview, 1960-04-08
items.q: but I was hearing Baby Dodds and Johnny Dodds and Lee Collins and all the greats

ctx.x: You can tell that from the Tin Roof Blues. There's three masters. That's right.

They were all different because rap couldn't play the same solos. We have Raymond Boyk in that same category. I could be rehearsing here and tell Raymond would come out with a good solo, and I said, that's the one I want, Raymond. Well, I can't get it back because Raymond's not going to play it anymore the same way. Well, those fellas are really playing from the heart, Bill. Then we came along, and I started out. I went up to Spring Hill College, and that was around the 25, 26. But before that, I had a chance to…
You went to Chicago in the early days. Tell me some more about your playing. You probably gave up clarinet.
